SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_sold_date_sk < (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2001-05-02') THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_sold_date_sk >= (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2001-05-02') THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales cs
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
JOIN warehouse ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN date_dim ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01'
WHERE item.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
